newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary BUBOR rates fall after repo rate cuts.
newsitem.headline: Hungary BUBOR rates fall after repo rate cuts.

text.p: Hungary's Budapest Interbank Offered Rates (BUBOR) fell sharply on Monday for all three maturities, the National Bank of Hungary (NBH) said.
The one-month rate was fixed at 20.55 percent, down 0.20, the three-month rate at 20.25 percent, down 0.19, and the six-month rate at 19.75, down 0.20.
Monday's sharp fall in the BUBOR rates follows a 25 basis point cut in four of the central bank's five repo rate facilities.
